intro: This repo holds Markdown documents only: the contributor guide, the roadmap, the team directory, and other org documents. There is nothing to install, build, or run.
prerequisites: A GitHub account, to fork the repo and open a pull request.

steps.title: Read the documents
steps.text: Start with `README.md`. It describes the project and how to make a first contribution. `Roadmap.md` gives the feature plans, `TEAM.md` the team directory, `BDD-GUIDE.md` the BDD process, and `Issues-lndex.md` the issue lists of the repos. GitHub renders all of them. On your machine, any Markdown viewer shows them.

steps.title: Propose an edit
steps.text: Greenstand uses the fork and pull model. Make your change on a new branch of your fork, then open a pull request against the `master` branch. Keep each pull request small and focused on one issue.
code: git commit -am "Fix a typo in README.md"
